description: Compute SHA-256 or legacy MD5 text digests. Use for non-secret content fingerprints; generate-token creates new IDs instead. Returns a hex digest; unsuitable for password storage or key derivation.

algo.description: Digest algorithm: sha-256 (default) or legacy md5.

text.description: Public or synthetic text to digest; never send secrets for hashing.

name: generate-hash
title: Compute a text digest
